description: Qatar University's Gemini Enterprise service with QU credential access and institutional Microsoft-data connectors.
howToObtain: Visit gemini.qu.edu.qa and log in with Qatar University credentials.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: Qatar University ITS says to access Gemini Enterprise, visit gemini.qu.edu.qa and log in with Qatar University credentials. The FAQ specifies daily Gemini Enterprise query, research-report, image, video and agent limits and describes optional Outlook, OneDrive and SharePoint connections.
